jobs.title: (Fluent English) Full-Cycle Sales Representative (remote)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a confident and empathic Full-Cycle Sales Representative to join the team of one of our clients. In this role, you’ll own the whole sales cycle: from the first call with an inbound lead to closing the deal and collecting payment on the spot. The ideal candidate feels at home on the phone, explains product value in plain words to non-technical business owners, and turns hesitation into a clear “yes.”

Ready to close your next deal? Let’s see what it takes 💛

What you will do:

  • Contact inbound leads within 5 minutes of their request via phone or email, qualify decision-makers, and pitch the product’s value;
  • Run up to 5 focused product demos per day, handle objections in real time, and collect payment directly on the call;
  • Make around 20 targeted outbound calls daily from curated lead lists, using multi-touch outreach across phone and email to connect with business owners and general managers;
  • Keep records of calls, demos, pipeline stages, and notes in the CRM for accurate forecasting and zero lead leakage;
  • Use internal spreadsheets, formulas, filters, and digital workspaces (Slack, Notion, CRM, AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT) to structure your day, prioritize accounts, and make your outreach more efficient.
